references.text: The original command from God to Moses to insert the poles into the rings of the ark in order to carry it. Exodus 37:5 describes the fulfillment of this command.
A similar instruction regarding poles and rings for the table of showbread, illustrating the consistent pattern for how holy objects were to be carried.
Parallel text concerning poles and rings for the table, demonstrating the same construction method used for other sacred items in the tabernacle.
Instructions to the sons of Kohath about carrying the holy objects, including the ark, using the poles.
The sons of Kohath were given no carts because they were to carry the holy objects on their shoulders using the poles.
Describes how the poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place when the ark was placed in Solomon's temple.
A parallel account in Chronicles regarding the poles of the ark when it was placed in Solomon's temple.
Parallel description of the transport mechanism for the ark and the altar, emphasizing God's mobile presence.
Fulfillment of the original instruction: The source shows the execution of the message in this verse.
